name: Cinderella
source:
Initial Class: Marshal

A prideful young girl who exaggeratedly talks and acts like a rich lady. She has a tendency to lose track of what she says when speaking with [url=/c57596]Jack[/url].

Despite this, Cinderella has sudden mood bursts at times and is actually very modest. She also gets easily depressed when she's called out, thinks she may have worried someone or when somebody attacks her "mask". This also happens when she loses any part of her clothing and starts thinking she is nothing but a useless and ugly human. It also seems she's not used to being praised by others.
